ja369:1.1: Ky-āhaṃ devānam akaraṃ kiṃ pāpaṃ pakataṃ mayā yaṃ me sirasmiṃ ūhacca cakkaṃ bhamati matthake ti.
ja369:2.1: Atikkamma ramaṇakaṃ sadāmattañ ca dūbhakaṃ brahmattarañ ca pāsādaṃ ken' atthena idhāgato
ja369:3.1: ti. Ito bahutarā bhogā atra maññe bhavissare, iti etāya saññāya passa maṃ vyasanaṃ gatan ti.
ja369:4.1: Catubbhi aṭṭh' ajjhagamā aṭṭhāhi pi ca soḷasa (vol.I p..) soḷasāhi ca battiṃsa, atricchaṃ cakkam āsado, icchāhatassa posassa cakkaṃ bhamati matthake.
ja369:5.1: Uparivisālaṃ duppūraṃ icchāvisaṭagāminiṃ ye ca taṃ anugijjhanti te honti cakkadhārino ti.
